description: Fresh objectives for the scorer v3 impact-ranking test: the held-out parsing objectives with more than three open questions, plus new objectives written 2026-09-26. None was ranked before. Objectives were kept or excluded only on parser output (never on any ranking).

objectives.text: Start a side business tutoring math on weekends; I keep my full-time job.
I want to build an online course business from scratch, $400 budget, no paid ads, and ask me before you spend anything.
Start a firewood delivery business and reach $3,000 in sales over the next 90 days.
Turn $1,000 into a small vending machine business. Just advise me for now.
I'd like to make extra money selling seedlings in the spring, 12 hours a week, within 8 weeks.
